title: Per-AC expansion record (v1)
description: One JSON object per acceptance criterion. Produced by a non-builder expansion author before any build dispatch; frozen (sha-recorded) and human-accepted before the engine will dispatch. Consumers: scripts/check_expansion.py (shape validation), scripts/reconcile.py (legs 1,3,4), scripts/make_gate.py + the integration gate's per-AC mutation duty (violating_behaviors), scripts/report.py (expected mutant counts).

ac_id.description: Must exist in the governing spec (reconcile leg 3 verifies; check_expansion checks shape only).

partitions.description: Equivalence partitions the AC text left implicit. Each entry must be referenced by a case (substring of some cases[].case) or waived via covered_by (reconcile leg 3).

boundaries.description: Boundary values. Same reference-or-waiver rule as partitions.

negatives.description: Negative inputs/paths. Referenced by a case, or waived via negatives_covered_by or covered_by.

invariants.description: Invariants other ACs or the integration gate carry; informational for the gate author.

violating_behaviors.description: Abstract mutant descriptions, frozen before the run. Consumed by the integration gate's per-AC mutation list (one mutant per entry, ids mut:<ac_id>:<n>) and counted by report.py.

unit.description: Acceptance-unit id this AC's eval slice hangs on. Mutually exclusive with residual:true (DS-8).

impl_units.description: Implementation-unit ids (one signature-bearing interface item each), separate from the acceptance unit (DS-8).

test.description: Existing test node, path::function form; reconcile leg 1 verifies existence.

covered_by.description: AC id that covers this record's expansion items wholesale; acts as an explicit waiver for unreferenced items (reconcile leg 3).

negatives_covered_by.description: AC id that covers the negatives; waives unreferenced negatives only.

residual.description: true = cross-unit residual: no unit binding allowed; the AC routes to the integration gate.

no_expansion_needed.description: Required true when all five expansion arrays are empty (DS-9); must carry no_expansion_reason. Such a record is exempt from the gate's mutation list (no violating_behaviors to mutate).
